changeSet.author: gymrat
changeSet.sql: UPDATE "Exercises" AS exercise SET "MovementPattern" = staging."MovementPattern" FROM "ExerciseInstructionsStaging" AS staging WHERE staging."Name" = exercise."Name"

changeSet.author: gymrat
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO "ExerciseSecondaryMuscles" ("ExerciseId", "Muscle") SELECT DISTINCT exercise."Id", CASE part.value WHEN 'Anterior Deltoid' THEN 'FrontDeltoids' ELSE replace(initcap(part.value), ' ', '') END FROM "Exercises" AS exercise CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT btrim(item) AS value FROM regexp_split_to_table(exercise."SubMuscles", ',') AS item ) AS part WHERE exercise."SubMuscles" IS NOT NULL AND part.value <> ''

changeSet.author: gymrat
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO "ExerciseTranslations" ("ExerciseId", "Culture", "Name", "Description", "Setup", "Execution") SELECT exercise."Id", 'en', exercise."Name", exercise."Description", staging."Setup", staging."Execution" FROM "Exercises" AS exercise JOIN "ExerciseInstructionsStaging" AS staging ON staging."Name" = exercise."Name"

changeSet.author: gymrat

rollback.sql: UPDATE "Exercises" AS exercise SET "SubMuscles" = ( SELECT string_agg("Muscle", ', ' ORDER BY "Muscle") FROM "ExerciseSecondaryMuscles" AS secondary WHERE secondary."ExerciseId" = exercise."Id"), "Description" = ( SELECT translation."Description" FROM "ExerciseTranslations" AS translation WHERE translation."ExerciseId" = exercise."Id" AND translation."Culture" = 'en')
